A Lithuanian Running Cup stage for both recreational and professional runners
additional: The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another participant until advance registration closes, subject to a €10 change fee. Registration and entry fee administration is handled by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The event took place on 2026-03-15, but the planned date is 2027-03-21; the course is not marked, participants choose their own route, and navigation and tactics are important.

name: Międzyzdrojska Liga Biegowa
location: Wapnica, Międzyzdroje, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Riešės krosas
location: Riešės hipodrome, Vilniaus r., Vilnius, Lithuania
description: Riešė Cross is a traditional cross-country running event held at the Riešė Hippodrome in Vilnius District. The event aims to promote cross-country running and athletics, encourage a healthy lifestyle, and increase physical activity. The course is 100% natural, comprising the hippodrome track, field paths, forest trails, and grass, making for a varied and hilly run. Participants are divided into age groups, and all finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, while age-group winners receive prizes.
course_highlights: 100% natural surface: hippodrome track, field paths, forest trail, and grass
Hilly course, with possible mud or snow depending on weather conditions
Different lap counts according to age groups and distances
additional: Race numbers will be issued on race day from 09:30 to 10:50 near the start-finish area. The race program may change depending on the number of participants; any changes will be announced when race numbers are collected. Participants are responsible for their own health, while parents or guardians are responsible for minors. All finishers receive commemorative souvenirs, and age-group winners and runners-up receive medals, cash prizes, and other prizes. The event will take place on 2027-03-27 at the Riešė Hippodrome in Vilnius District and is intended to encourage an active lifestyle and a sense of community.

name: ULTRA 55 !!!
location: Bėgimo namai Kūjagalviai, Kauno rajonas, Lithuania
description: ULTRA 55!!! is a birthday ultrarun held to honour the 55th birthday of Vidas Totilas, a long-time advocate of running. The event takes place at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai, Kaunas District, and aims to promote long-distance running in Lithuania and grow the long-distance running community. The course follows forest and field tracks, with sandy sections; the start and finish are at the same location. Anyone may participate, regardless of age, gender or nationality, and participation is free.
course_highlights: Forest and field tracks
Sandy sections along the course
Start and finish at Bėgimo namai in Kūjagalviai
additional: Registration is available online and on race day from 9:30 to 10:55. Participation is free. All finishers receive commemorative medals, with awards in the overall and age-group categories. After the finish, participants can enjoy hot soup, snacks and drinks, as well as a sauna and hot tub. The event is part of the Bėgimo namai race series, is held annually and attracts experienced ultrarunners.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 4/5
description: Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, offering accessible road races in Hakunila, Vantaa. The series consists of five events, with 5 km and 10 km distances. The races attract a wide range of participants and are run on officially measured courses in sunny spring weather. Buying a series pass makes it easy to take part in all the events without registering separately each time. The event has a long tradition and also offers the opportunity to join running classes and coaching.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses in Hakunila, Vantaa
Fast, high-quality winter races
Races are held in sunny spring weather and attract a wide range of participants
additional: A series pass covers all five events, with no separate registration required. Race numbers must be collected from the race office and returned after each race. Changing distance is possible at the information desk up to half an hour before the start. Members of Kenttäurheilijat-58 ry can take part with a series pass at no cost once their membership fee has been paid. Exact event details and results; no direct mention of the price or any special course features.

name: Pyrzycka Szybka Dycha Bieg Smoka - Pyrzycki Bieg Dzieci
VII Bieg i Nordic Walking Szukamy Bocian...
XII Ostrowski Półmaraton
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Cross Island Bornholm 2027 - ½ marathon og 10 km
Bėgimas „Runway Run 2026“
location: Lietuvos oro pajėgų bazė, Šiauliai, Lithuania
description: Runway Run 2026 is a 3 km run held at the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. The event offers a unique opportunity to run on a runway, an unusual and exciting place to race. It is intended for school pupils, college students, the community, and the public, promoting an active lifestyle and sports. Participants can enjoy the distinctive atmosphere and test their abilities on this special course.
course_highlights: 3 km run on a runway
Location: Lithuanian Air Force Base, Šiauliai
Unique running course within the airport grounds
additional: The event is intended for school pupils, college students, the college community, and the public. Registration is open, but prices and registration deadlines were not specified. Free parking spaces may be available for students. The event takes place in a setting organized by Šiauliai State College. The event date is April 3, 2027; the distance is 3 km; the location is the Lithuanian Air Force Base in Šiauliai. Registration details were not specified.

name: Trailo kalvės S4E5. Bražuolė. Finalas
description: Trailo Kalvė S4E5 Bražuolė Finalas is the final event of the traditional Lithuanian Trail Running Cup season, held in the Bražuolė area. The event offers a range of distances for participants of different ages and experience levels, from youth to adults. The courses wind through woodland and vary in length and difficulty, offering both natural beauty and challenges. Participants start at the Bražuolė campsite, and the event is friendly and open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in the Bražuolė area
Distances of varying lengths, from 4.8 km to 24.8 km
Courses with varied elevation gain and scenic natural views
additional: Start at the Bražuolė campsite. Courses feature elevation gains ranging from up to 150 m to over 500 m, depending on the distance. The event has youth and adult categories. Event merchandise is inspired by forest animals, and part of the proceeds goes to support care organizations. The event offers different distances, registration is online, and the location is Bražuolė campsite, Pugainiai.

name: 20 Półmaraton Warszawski LET’S RUN THIS PARTY!
V Bieg W samo południe
location: Samborowo, Ostróda County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organized by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård in Södertälje. The race offers several categories for children, youth and adults, with distances ranging from approximately 600 metres to 10 kilometres. This well-established event will be held for the 49th time in 2027 and offers an enjoyable and challenging running experience in scenic surroundings. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-site late registration available. Swedish Athletics Federation competition rules apply.
course_highlights: Classic road and cross-country race
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård
Several distances from 600 m to 10 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). Start times for children’s and youth categories are between 11:00 and 11:35, while adult categories start at 12:30. Results and start lists will be published on the website. Participation constitutes consent to the publication of names and any photographs on the association’s website and social media. Regular registration closes on 27 March. On-site late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start and costs extra. Everyone is welcome in the recreational category.

name: Hallarydsloppet
description: Hallarydsloppet is an annual running race held on Easter Monday at Hallaryd School. The race is suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from 1.2 km for the youngest participants to 21 km in the main event. The courses run mostly along gravel roads and paved sections through beautiful landscapes of winding stone walls, meadows and forests on the border between Skåne and Småland. Shorter routes of 3.2 km, 6 km and 9.8 km are also available and are suitable for both running and walking. The event offers timing, water stations and prizes for the top finishers in each class, as well as a plaque for everyone who completes the race.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.hallarydsloppet.se/): 2027-03-29 — "Hallarydsloppet 29 mars 2027" (was estimated 2027-04-05)

name: Ryssbergsloppet
description: Ryssbergsloppet is an annual running event in Sölvesborg organised by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers several distances of varying lengths and difficulty, making it accessible to both beginners and experienced runners. It is part of Skånes VeteranCup and features a scenic, challenging course through beautiful terrain. The organisers welcome runners of all ages and categories to a well-organised and enjoyable race day.
course_highlights: The course is marked with arrows, painted lines and ribbons at every kilometre
Water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish
The terrain varies, with sections through woodland and hilly stretches
additional: Race numbers must be collected at Sparbankshallen, Bromölla, no later than 30 minutes before the start. All participants must wear their race number on the front of their chest. The prize-giving ceremony takes place at approximately 12:30. Medical assistance is available at the start/finish. Refreshments, including coffee and grilled sausages, are available. Marshals are stationed at junctions to show the way. There are several race distances, with start times between 10:30 and 11:10, and results are published on the club’s website. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Kanallöpet
location: Bergvallen, Borensberg, Motala Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10-kilometre race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a course in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness ahead of upcoming races or get their running year underway with the help of experienced pacers. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of surfaces: asphalt, gravel and paving slabs.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården with 117 metres of elevation gain
Surfaces: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
Start and finish approximately 500 metres from Universitetet metro station
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Minimum age: 15 (born in 2012). Walking poles, strollers, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participation is allowed subject to special conditions, with participants starting in the final start group. Water stations are strategically placed along the course. The provisional start time is 11:00, and the time limit is two hours. Water stations and medical services are available along the course and at the start and finish area.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen, offering three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km. The races are open to all runners, from elite athletes to recreational runners, and participants in the 25 km race must be at least 17 years old. The courses include both classic routes and new trails, with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful views of nature. After the race, a classic Giffa burger is included for the 10 km and 25 km races, or a hot dog in a bun for the 5 km race, along with a drink. There is no time limit, and the 25 km race is part of the Skåne Trailcup.
course_highlights: A technical trail race on the heights of Romeleåsen
Courses with plenty of elevation gain and beautiful natural views
Three distances: 5 km, 10 km and 25 km, featuring both classic routes and new trails
additional: Showers and changing rooms are available after the race. Water and energy stations are located along the course and at the finish. The 25 km race is the first event in the Skåne Trailcup. There is no time limit; the race ends when all participants have reached the finish. Previous editions have had water and energy stations along the course and at the finish, as well as showers and changing rooms. Food and drink after the finish have been included in the entry fee.

name: Cross maraton u Ryśka vol 82
location: Wieluń-Ruda, Wieluń County, Łódź Voivodeship, Poland

name: SpriT Frontyard - Genarp
description: SpriT Frontyard Genarp is a fast and fun trail running race at Genarpsbadet, suitable for all levels and ambitions. The course is approximately 1 km long and consists of gravel road, forest trail and sand, with no asphalt, and two small hills at the beginning. The aim is to run as many laps as you can within time limits that gradually decrease. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish, and great prizes are awarded to many participants.
course_highlights: A mix of gravel road, forest trail and sand
Two small hills at the beginning of the course
A fast course with a thrilling finish along the final straight
additional: You have 10 minutes for the first lap, 9 minutes and 40 seconds for the second lap, 9 minutes and 20 seconds for the third lap, and so on. Water, cola and other treats are available at the lap point and after the finish. Great prizes are awarded to many participants. Registration is binding once payment has been made. The organizer recommends insurance in case of injury or illness. The race information found applies to previous editions; the price and details for 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a six-leg relay race that starts and finishes in Bruksparken in Bromölla. The course is flat and easy to run, with a varied gravel and asphalt surface, making it suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. The focus is on community and the joy of running, and all teams start at the same time. In the anniversary year, a Mini Race for children is also held, with a medal and certificate for every participant.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Start and finish in the heart of Bruksparken, Bromölla
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Timing is provided by data chip, and both the total finish time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and prizes are also drawn for all participants. The Mini Race for children starts below Bruksparken, with a group warm-up at 10:20. After finishing, all children receive a medal, certificate, drink and fruit. The event includes a mini category for children and is open to both recreational and elite runners. Participants can expect chip timing to record total and individual times.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course runs along the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches, on an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal in recognition of their achievement. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. The warm-up is led by Fitness4You before the start. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is available until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with options for company tents, registration via the website, race bib collection at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm, offering both half-marathon and 10 km distances. The race follows flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to set a personal best. The event is a celebration for all, with the start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half-marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a celebration for all, with flat courses suited to setting a personal best. There is also a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus services and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, children’s race for up to age 13

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre invites everyone to take part in a run celebrating World Health Day. This is a community-focused, active event aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, and strengthening the physical and mental health of the community. It is a great opportunity for families, children, young people, and older adults to come together and spend time actively in Kėdainiai. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which supports the organization of mass physical activity events.
course_highlights: Physical activity sessions
Health screenings
Community engagement
additional: The event is open to all age groups—families, children, young people, and older residents. It is organized by the Lithuanian Sports Society „Žalgiris“ and Kėdainiai Sports Centre. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which promotes mass participation in physical activity. It includes a range of physical activity sessions, screenings, sports competitions, and lectures, and will take place in the city of Kėdainiai, with the central city stadium as the main venue.

name: VIII Festiwal Pieszo-Biegowy Przedwiośni...
location: Masłów, Masłów Municipality, Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Tjust Trail Run
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging and sweaty competition on winding trails, over beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic nature of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running across varied terrain. Welcome to a wonderful running experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Sections over beautiful rocky outcrops
Beautiful and varied terrain
additional: Changes to the race distance are possible by email until 31 March. On the longest distance (The Long Run), runners must complete a lap by 11:45 to be allowed to continue for the second lap. Race bibs must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If withdrawing, participants must notify a race official or call the number provided. Transport can be arranged from aid stations if needed. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. Distance changes can be made until 31 March.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: 10 april 2027 kommer Tjust Bike & Running Club anordna den elfte upplagan av TJUST TRAIL RUN.

name: Kurts 300:e maraton - halvmaran
description: Kurt’s 300th Marathon is a special race organized by Hultsfreds Löparklubb to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The race follows a 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred, combining park paths and asphalt. The half marathon consists of two long laps and one shorter lap. The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, where changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen
20% asphalt, the rest park paths
Two water stations offering water, sports drink, cola, and fruit
additional: The start and finish are at the entrance to Knektavallen, facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bib numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen at the restaurant. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned. The start and finish are at Knektavallen; changing rooms, showers, toilets, and water stations are available according to the organizer’s information.

name: 42 Bieg Szpęgawski
location: Szpęgawsk, Starogard County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: IX Mazurski Bieg na Kulke
location: Kulka, Szczytno County, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
Hässleholmsloppet
description: Hässleholmsloppet is a trail race held at the beautiful Hovdala Castle in Hässleholm. The race offers three distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5.4 km. All courses feature gentle, winding trails through varied woodland, with stretches alongside water. The longest course, 21 km, is part of Spring i Skåne’s Trail Cup and offers extra elevation and a scenic route. The race is open to both recreational runners and young people; the recommended minimum age for the longest distance is 17.
course_highlights: Gentle, winding trails through varied woodland
Sections alongside water along the courses
The 21 km course is a scenic route at Hovdala with extra elevation
additional: Start and finish at Hovdala Castle. Runners should arrive 10 minutes before the start. Bibs must be collected at the venue at least 30 minutes before the start and worn visibly at the front. Electronic timing is used. There are no shower or changing facilities, but toilets are available. Water and sports drink stations are available on all courses. The maximum number of participants is 400. Name changes are possible for a fee of 100 kr via the registration page. The race information specifies electronic timing, aid stations on all courses and a participant limit of 400. The prices and practical details apply to the published information for 2026.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Stockholm, with races for all ages. These include a Mini Race for the youngest participants, Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class through grade 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in disadvantaged suburbs through personal development using running. The day features music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children in preschool class through grade 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different age-group waves; 1.6 km Fun Run at 12:25; 5 km race at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Registration is free and open until 14 May at 17:00. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The event takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC (Tyresö Extreme Challenge) is an ultramarathon held at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö, Stockholm. The race offers several distances, including the 46 km MiniUltra, Backyard Ultra, 50 miles, 100 miles and 200 miles, on a scenic and challenging 11.5 km loop course. The start and finish are at the TEC tent beside the outdoor gym, and the race takes place over a weekend in April, with different start times for each distance. It is a tough and fun challenge for ultrarunners, with the option to change distances during the race.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop course at Alby Friluftsgård
Backyard Ultra course of approximately 6.7 km, with hourly starts
Aid station at the start/finish
additional: Start times: The 200 miles race starts Friday at 10:00, with a 54-hour time limit; Backyard Ultra starts Friday at 18:00, with hourly starts and a 46-hour time limit; the 50 and 100 miles races start Saturday at 10:00, with a 30-hour time limit; MiniUltra 46 km starts Sunday at 08:00, with an 8-hour time limit. Bibs can be collected from Friday at 08:00 at the TEC tent. Changing rooms, showers and sauna are currently unavailable due to renovation. It is not permitted to set up your own tents or aid tables at the start/finish or along the course. Runners’ bags are stored in the tent in the designated area. It is permitted to change distances during the race, but a Swedish record can only be set at the distance entered. The finish closes Sunday at 16:00. Previous editions have also included the 50 miles, 100 miles and Backyard Ultra distances. The sources do not provide information about the 2027 course or registration.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://new.tec100.se/?p=9313): 2027-04-16 — "16-18 april 2027 i Alby, Tyresö!" (was estimated 2027-04-16)

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international “Tropem Wilczym 2026” run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, and is dedicated to honoring members of the anti-Nazi, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with a strong focus on safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to take part in a meaningful sporting event.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Vingis Park near the band shell
Distances: the symbolic 1963 m run, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and a half marathon
The course will be closed and traffic restrictions introduced to ensure safety
additional: On race day, the timing system will operate until 13:30; after that, times will not be recorded. The number of participants is limited to 1,200. It is possible to switch to a shorter distance for a €2 fee. Participants must bring an ID document to collect their race bib. The event combines sport and history, offers several distances, including the symbolic 1,963-metre course, and emphasizes the importance of community. Participant age groups apply, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

name: Rock The Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan kan göras via hemsidan fram till tisdagen 13/4 kl 23.59

late_fee.price: Swish betalning på plats, hamburgare kan ta slut

description: Rock The Trail is a trail race on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten, Uppsala. The race offers four categories, including a children’s race of approximately 1.5 km and longer distances of 8 km, 16 km and 48 km. The start and finish are at OK Linné, and participants are offered hamburgers and drinks after the race. The course features scenic trails and mixed terrain, and the longer distances are registered with ITRA.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths across varied terrain in Hågadalen/Nåsten
The longer-distance course is approximately 16 km, adjusted from the previous 15.8 km
Children’s race of approximately 1.5 km around the start and finish area
additional: Late registration is available on site with payment by Swish, but hamburgers after the race may run out. Umara sports drink is served during the race. Toilets are available at the start/finish. Parking is limited; taking public transport or cycling is recommended. The start location is listed as OK Linné, Tallbacksvägen 68.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
price_range: 750 kr för vuxna; 400 kr för 13 år och yngre (angivna priser för 2026)
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon in which participants run a 6,706-metre loop on the Stensö exercise trail. The race starts at 10:00, with a new start every hour on the hour. To continue, runners must complete a lap within one hour. The winner is the person who completes the most laps, making the race an exciting, tactical challenge for ultrarunners of all levels.
course_highlights: Flat, gravel-surfaced trail on the Stensö exercise trail
The course is clearly marked with red-and-white ribbons and arrows
In the evening and at night, the course follows only the floodlit trail
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The 6,706 m loop is on the Stensö exercise trail (gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps equal 100 miles. Organiser: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is an annual running race organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb at Sollentunavallen in Sollentuna. The race offers runners of all ages a great opportunity to compete on a well-organized course, with good training facilities. Turebergs Friidrottsklubb is an experienced organizer that also hosts several other athletics and running events throughout the year. Sollentunavallen is a centrally located, easily accessible venue that contributes to a pleasant race environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the running track at Sollentunavallen
Organized by Turebergs Friidrottsklubb, an experienced club
Centrally located venue with good training facilities
additional: Turebergs Friidrottsklubb covers up to 15 race entries per season for its members. Late registration and failure to participate are charged to the participant. Training at Sollentunavallen may be affected by other events and football matches, but the track is generally available for running. Previous editions have offered Minivarvet for children. Information about the course and event is based on previous years' races and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt 300 Marathon in Hultsfred is a welcoming and inclusive race celebrating Kurt Gustavsson’s 300th marathon and his 80th birthday. The event offers both a marathon and a half marathon on a scenic 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, combining park paths and asphalt. The course is officially measured and the race is sanctioned, with timing and refreshment stations along the route. After the race, participants are invited to a social gathering with food and good company near the start and finish area.
course_highlights: 5-lap course along Lake Hulingen, with the final lap 3 km shorter
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park paths
Two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola and energy supplies, at the lap point and at 4 km
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Bibs are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to finish in over 5 hours start at 09:00. After the race, a social gathering with food and good company is planned for around 14:30, about 1 km from Knektavallen. Start and finish at Knektavallen. The official club announcement applies to 2026 and lists prices for the marathon and half marathon; prices and practical details for 2027 have not been confirmed in the sources.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Bieg Pamięci - wokół Góry Śmierci
location: Paszczyna, Dębica County, Subcarpathian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The traditional international Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė run is an annual spring sports celebration held in Baltoji Vokė. This traditional race brings together running enthusiasts from Lithuania and abroad. The event has a long history and a friendly atmosphere that encourages an active lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: Traditional Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė route
Part of the spring sports celebration
Held annually since at least 2018
additional: The event takes place during the spring sports celebration. Registration is managed by the Lithuanian Running Cup. In previous years, the start time was usually 11:00. Several hundred athletes take part; the event includes awards, sponsor support, and safety arrangements.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
Skrylleloppet
description: Skrylleloppet is a trail race organized by Björnstorps IF at Skryllegården in Södra Sandby. Races are offered over 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, with the 3 km race also having recreational categories for men and women. The courses follow Skryllegården’s fitness trails through varied woodland terrain on gravel surfaces. Skrylleloppet is a welcoming race with professional timing and results reporting, and also serves as a qualifying race for the TCS Lidingöloppet.
course_highlights: Trail race on varied woodland trails
Gravel surfaces on fitness trails
The 10 km race offers the opportunity to qualify for the TCS Lidingöloppet
additional: Registration is available online until 30 minutes before the start. On race day, participants can also register on site and make a name or category change for an administrative fee of 100 kr; payment is by Swish only. Bib numbers are sent by email during race week and can also be collected from Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race. Participants who cycle to the race can enter a prize draw at the awards ceremony at 11:30. Parking is limited, so carpooling is recommended.

name: Skälbyloppet
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly race through the scenic surroundings of Skälby Gård in Kalmar. The event offers several distances, from short 600-metre youth races to 8 km for adults, on routes featuring lovely park paths, gravel, asphalt and trail. It’s a perfect race to kick off the running season, with water available on the lap and at the finish. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal as a memento.
course_highlights: The course runs on gravel and park paths, with a short section on asphalt and some trail.
Water is available on the lap of the long course and at the finish.
The 4 km and 8 km courses are one and two laps respectively, crossing the bridge.
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Skälby loge on race day from 8:30 a.m. Youth races start from 10:00 a.m.; adult men’s and women’s races start at 11:00 a.m. New: a 4 km untimed walking category. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Information about previous editions also lists a 4 km untimed walking category. All finishers receive a medal. The published information applies to the 2026 race and does not confirm the date of 24 April 2027.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon that runs through scenic parts of Gärdet and Södra Djurgården in Stockholm. The start and finish are at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen. The race is perfect preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, but also suits anyone who wants to welcome spring with a great half marathon in an urban setting. The course has been officially measured and features a varied mix of asphalt, gravel and paving stones, with a total elevation gain of 183 metres.
course_highlights: The course runs through Gärdet and Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Sportgärdet on Lindarängsvägen
Surfaces include asphalt, gravel and paving stones
Total elevation gain of 183 metres, with kilometre markers at every kilometre
additional: The race has a time limit of 3 hours. Enervit sports drink will be available during the race. Bib collection takes place at Gärdet sports field on Friday 24 April from 10:00 to 19:00 and Saturday 25 April from 08:00 to 11:00. Participants who collect their bib on Friday receive IcePower Cold Gel and a Scholl foot mask. Registered participants receive 25% off adidas shoes and clothing at the adidas pop-up store at Löplabbet from 20–26 April. Race rules prohibit, among other things, strollers, inline skates, roller skis and competition wheelchairs. Wheelchair participants start in the final starting group, and guides are free of charge. The provisional start time is 11:00 and the time limit is three hours. Minimum age: 17. Race-day registration is available until 09:00, subject to availability.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
location: Olshammar, Askersund Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 550:-  för individuell start inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900:- för ett lag inkl. hyra för SI-pinne.

description: Munkastigen Trailrun is an ultramarathon through the enchanted forests of Tiveden, from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå. The race follows a historic trail used by monks in the 15th century and offers challenging, scenic terrain. A new course is planned for 2027, with a longer distance of approximately 53 km for the Swedish Championship categories. The course is well marked, and participants receive a map to minimize the risk of taking a wrong turn.
course_highlights: Historic trail used by monks in the 15th century
Enchanted forest landscape in Tiveden
Well-marked course with two aid stations
additional: Bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee for individual starters. For teams, transport is included for the first runner. Timing is recorded using SportIdent every 10 km. Participants receive a plaque and are served a hot meal after finishing. Teams can consist of 2–5 runners, with exchanges permitted anywhere along the course. The regular race can be completed individually or in teams of 2–5 runners. There are two aid stations, and bus transport from Laxå to the start in Olshammar is included in the entry fee. Finishers receive a plaque and a hot meal after finishing. The organizer’s website contains maps, an elevation profile, and a GPX file.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly trails through forests and meadows and along the archipelago coast, with a soft, gentle surface suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race qualifies runners for seeding at TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to get a better start group in the classic autumn trail race. Water and sports drinks are available at aid stations, and there is entertainment along the course. After the race, refreshments and light food are available to buy at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest trails and hilly terrain
The course is mostly on soft trails and gravel
Beautiful scenery featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Aid stations with water and sports drinks at 5 km and at the finish. The course is marked with white flagging tape and spray-painted arrows, with course marshals at difficult points. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available at Lidingövallen. Free bag storage is available, but not for electronic items. Valuables storage costs 20 kr. Group warm-up before the start. Public transport or cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Category changes and name changes are possible for a fee. A children’s race (Knattarnas Vårmil) takes place before the main races. The 10 km starts at 11:00 and the 5 km at 11:10 on 24 April 2027. The 10 km course has an aid station at 5 km and drinks at the finish. Parking is limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

name: VXO Ultrafest
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning festival and Swedish Championships organized by Växjö Löparklubb in collaboration with the Swedish Athletics Association. The event takes place on the southern shore of Lake Trummen in Växjö and offers several championship distances, including 24-hour running and 100 km. The course is flat and consists mainly of asphalt with some gravel sections, making it fast and spectator-friendly. Both runners and walkers are welcome for a weekend of challenge and community.
course_highlights: Flat loop course of approximately 820 meters on asphalt and gravel
Approximately 3.2 km loop around Lake Trummen on asphalt and gravel
Event area on open grassy spaces on the southern shore of Lake Trummen
additional: The pre-race dinner is held on Friday, April 24. Lap counting takes place at the arena, where there is room for the organizer's tents and participants' own tents. The women's SM half-marathon walk starts at 10:00. The VXO24h course is approximately 820 m, while the courses for VXO100k and the SM 42 km and 21 km walking events are approximately 3.2 km around Lake Trummen. The organizer's website states that VXO Ultrafest is taking a break after five years; no event in 2027 has been confirmed.

name: Vårmilen
organizer: Lidingöloppet (IFK Lidingö Friidrott och IFK Lidingö Skid- och Orienteringsklubb)
price_range: 200–500 kr (2026 års priser; varierar beroende på distans och anmälningsdatum)
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge offering one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. The race takes place on scenic, hilly forest roads, through meadows and along the archipelago coast, with soft trails that make it a gentle start to the running season. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The race also counts toward seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to start in a better starting group at the classic autumn trail race. There are water and sports drink stations along the course, as well as music and entertainment. After the races, refreshments and light meals are available to buy at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads and hilly terrain
Most of the course runs on soft trails
Scenic landscapes featuring forests, meadows and the archipelago coast
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Water and Enervit sports drink stations along the course. Music and entertainment along the course. Knattarnas Vårmil for children up to 5 years old, with a medal and surprise after the finish. Public transport to Lidingövallen is recommended. Parking is limited and payable via Swish. Class changes and name changes are available for a fee via Mina sidor or on site. Water and Enervit sports drink stations, as well as music and activities, along the course. Refreshments and light meals are available to buy at Lidingövallen before and after the races.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: The Kauno Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas, attracting thousands of participants. The event is for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level, and aims to promote social and physical activity and healthy-lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by World Athletics (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sporting celebration for both professionals and recreational runners, held in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
The course is measured according to international standards
The event is certified with a 5-star quality label
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality label, ensuring the highest standards of safety and service. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is for both professionals and recreational runners and takes place in Kaunas. It is organized by the public institution "Kauno maratono klubas". The event offers a virtual running option, group registration, various distances, and certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Bålsta Stadslopp is a fast and enjoyable spring race held in central Bålsta, starting and finishing at Gröna Dalens IP. The race has grown steadily since it began in 2019 and is known as a PB course, where many runners beat their previous records. The course is a 5 km loop that can be run once or twice, with 99% asphalt and a finish on an athletics track. The event is marked by speed, joy and community, and welcomes runners of all ages and categories.
course_highlights: 5 km loop in central Bålsta, finishing at Gröna Dalens IP
99% asphalt, with a finish on an athletics track
Fast course with a small incline removed to make even faster times possible
additional: Bib collection starts at 08:00 outside Gröna Dalens IP. Start times are 09:30 for 5 km and 10:45 for 10 km. Runners self-seed at the start to reduce congestion. Late registration is available online until 1 hour before the start, subject to availability. There is a bag drop and limited changing facilities. Take the commuter train to Bålsta station, within walking distance of the start/finish. Several parking areas are nearby. Badhusvägen is closed to traffic on race day. Registration is open. The sports drink served in the cups is Umara U Sport Lemon.

name: Landsjön runt

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Landsjön Runt is a traditional road race organized by IK Vista since 1982 in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. The event offers several distances for the whole family, from a children’s race and obstacle course to 5.5 km and 12.5 km in scenic surroundings around the lake. The start and finish are at Vistavallen, and the course runs clockwise around the lake, with the climbs in the first half. Participants can enjoy music and refreshments along the way for a great running experience. There are also team competitions and awards for youth and Fun Run participants.
course_highlights: The course runs clockwise around Landsjön, with climbs in the first half
The start is on the grass field and the finish is on the running track at Vistavallen
Scenic surroundings, with the course running beside the waters of Landsjön
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Vistavallen on the Saturday before the event, between 14:00 and 16:00. IK Vista members can participate for free if they register by 18/4. A team competition for teams of four is available for the 5.5 km and 12.5 km races. Each team’s total time is recorded, and teams receive a bag of treats. The children’s race for ages 0–6, approximately 500 m, starts at 12:00. The Vista FUN RUN obstacle course, approximately 1 km, starts at 12:20, with an awards ceremony afterward. Recommended parking is at Vistavallen or Hunnerydsbadet; use of public transport is encouraged. The race has been held annually since 1982.

name: Orion Trail
description: Orion Trail is a beautiful running race in the scenic Ådalen valley in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona, where participants run along trails beside a winding stream. The course offers varied terrain, including trails, off-road sections, gravel roads and asphalt, as well as a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. The race offers distances of 5 km and 10 km; the 10 km race consists of two laps of the course. The youngest participants can take part in a 500- or 1,000-metre children’s race. All participants receive a medal, a drink and a bun, and showers and refreshments are available at the finish. Orion Trail is part of Oriondagen, a family-friendly day with activities in nature.
course_highlights: The course is approximately 5,000 metres long, including 3,700 metres of trails and off-road terrain
The route follows the scenic Ådalen valley beside a winding stream and a waterfall
The children’s race is 500 or 1,000 metres, with the option of running one or two laps
additional: The start and finish are at Orionstugan in Jämjö, with parking in the designated area. Race numbers can be collected from 09:00 on race day. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal, a drink and a bun. Showers and changing facilities are available. Refreshments, including grilled sausages, hamburgers, cakes and coffee, are on offer. Entries can be made on site up to 30 minutes before the start. Oriondagen runs from 10:00 to 13:00 and includes several family activities, with drop-in participation. Start times: 5 km and 10 km at 10:30; children’s race at 12:00. The race can be completed by running or walking.

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
description: Strömsnäs Trailrun is a lovely trail race held in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd. The races mainly follow trails and forest roads, with some off-trail terrain, offering a nature-rich and challenging running experience. The event is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and welcomes runners in various classes, with honorary prizes and medals for everyone who finishes. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk, and the organiser, SK Graal, looks forward to welcoming participants for a great day in their running shoes.
course_highlights: Run on trails, forest roads and off-trail terrain
Scenic forests around Strömsnäsbruk and Traryd
Start and finish at Graalstugan
additional: The start and finish are at Graalstugan. Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib, which must be returned at the finish. The prize-giving ceremony is at approximately 12:30, with honorary prizes for places 1–3 in each class and prizes awarded by draw. All finishers receive a medal. Changing rooms and showers are available, with limited space. There is a cafeteria near the finish area. Late registration is available on race day from 09:30 until 30 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 60 SEK. Clubs may be invoiced when registering more than three participants. The start and finish are at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. Timing is electronic, and finishers receive a medal according to the 2026 information; the 2027 terms have not yet been confirmed.

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race held on Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, with the start and finish at Fisksjöäng. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting at 11:00 and 12:00, respectively. The course offers a wonderful experience in nature, with varied terrain, and is easy to reach by public transport. The event is open to young people aged 11 and over when accompanied by a parent or guardian, and has a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. All participants receive a medal, refreshments along the course and race timing with a bib.
course_highlights: Trail running on Norra Djurgården through varied natural scenery
Start and finish at Fisksjöäng, near Ropsten metro station
Refreshment stations along the course and chip timing
additional: The start and finish are at Fisksjöäng, a 10-minute walk from Ropsten metro station. Bibs can be collected the Friday before the race at the Icebug store in Stockholm or at the venue on race day. The bib is personal and must be worn visibly on the chest, with the chip unfolded. A medal, refreshments along the course, finish-line services and race timing are included. Late registration is possible up to 1 hour before the start. Participants receive a discount on Icebug running shoes. A bib with race timing, refreshments along the course, a medal and finish-line services are included. The price information applies to the price periods listed on the organizer’s website and may refer to an edition other than 2027.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė yra unikalios ištvermės varžybos Alytuje, Dailidės ežero apylinkėse. Šis renginys kviečia bėgikus išbandyti savo ribas, bėgant Backyard ultra formato trasą, kuri padeda lengviau įveikti 100 mylių atstumą. Varžybose nugalėtojas bus tik vienas, o iššūkis yra didelis - lengva atrodo tik iki tam tikro momento. Tai puiki galimybė patirti tikrą ištvermės bėgimo dvasią ir garbingai užsitarnauti DNF statusą.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.
