pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varžybos ... yra nukeliamos į 2026 m. rugsėjo 30 d.

name: 16. ETAPP
description: The 16th stage is part of a recreational running series held in Tallinn. The event centre, start and finish are at Järve Health Trail, offering participants an enjoyable running and Nordic walking experience at the car park by the shared-use path. The route is easily accessible by car and public transport, making it convenient to take part. The series aims to offer everyone an opportunity to spend their free time in an active and healthy way.
course_highlights: Running and Nordic walking on Järve Health Trail
Start and finish at the car park by the Järve shared-use path
Easy access by car and public transport
additional: The event centre, start and finish are at the car park by the Järve shared-use path, at the Viljandi mnt end of Järve Health Trail. Those arriving by car are advised to park at Järve Selver, from where it is about a 400 m walk or jog to the event centre. Those travelling by bus should get off at the Risti stop, from where it is about a 300 m walk to the event centre.

name: ACE BATTLE RUN:  ACE BATTLE Mile indywidualni zawody rankingowe na dystan...
Friday Night Run 2026
description: Friday Night Run is an energetic night run in central Tartu, taking place on 2 October at Town Hall Square. The distance is approximately 4 km, along city streets, offering a chance to enjoy the atmosphere of the autumn city with friends. This is not a race; participants can choose to run with or without timing. The event features music and a live concert, creating a lively evening atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4 km course in central Tartu
The course runs along city streets and park paths
One split-timing point on the timed distance
additional: The race number must be pinned to the chest and visible throughout the distance. The timing chip is attached to the back of the race number and is for single use. Participants have 45 minutes to complete the course; the finish closes at 21:45. The entry fee includes a marked course, race number, timing (if using a chip), services at the finish, and medical assistance if needed. Registration is available online until 2 October at 17:00 and on site until 20:30. The event includes online and on-site registration, medals and T-shirts for participants, and group discounts.

name: VII-asis Utenos hipodromo maratonas
description: VII-asis Utenos Hipodromo Maratonas vyks 2026 m. spalio 3 d. Utenoje, moderniame Baltijos šalių hipodrome. Renginyje siūloma net 7 distancijos: maratonas, pusmaratonis, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, 1 km šeimų bėgimas ir 400 m vaikų bėgimas. Tai puiki galimybė tiek patyrusiems bėgikams, tiek šeimoms su vaikais aktyviai praleisti laiką ir išbandyti savo jėgas įvairiose trasose.

name: 15. Tartu Linnamaratoni Lastejooksud
description: Tartu Linnamaratoni lastejooksud on kõigile lastele avatud jooksuvõistlus, kus osalemisrõõm on peamine eesmärk. Distantside ja vanusegruppide osas on soovituslikud juhised, kuid iga laps on rajal oodatud ja võrdne. Stardinumbrid väljastatakse tund enne starti ning võistlust ei korraldata paremusjärjestuse alusel. Üritus toimub Tartu Raekoja platsil ning pakub võimalust osaleda nii eelregistreerunult kui ka kohapeal.

name: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazow...
description: VIII Bieg Zielonym Szlakiem Niziny Mazowieckiej to bieg na dystansie 5 km, który odbędzie się 27 września 2026 roku w Czerwonce Włościańskiej. Start i meta zlokalizowane są przy Szkole Podstawowej w Czerwonce. Zawody organizowane są przez lokalne kluby sportowe i instytucje, a trasa biegu przebiega malowniczym terenem Niziny Mazowieckiej. Impreza ma charakter otwarty dla osób dorosłych oraz młodzieży powyżej 15 lat za zgodą opiekuna prawnego.

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
John Bauer Trail Run
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held at the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget in Huskvarna. The race offers several distances for both adults and children, with a varied course that follows trails and, in places, untamed terrain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views over Lake Vättern and challenging hills, including the famous Strutsabacken, where the Bergatrollet competition takes place. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with activities and a sense of community around the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly terrain with both trails and untamed sections
Passage through Ulvadalen, with abundant flora and opportunities to experience nature
Strutsabacken—a steep ski slope where the Bergatrollet competition is decided
additional: Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15. Timing is done using the chip in the race bib and provides both total time and Strutsabacken hill time. Changing rooms with showers and toilets are available at the IKHP cabin. Water stations are located at several points, depending on the distance. Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00, if places remain. IKHP members receive half off the fee with a discount code. The event is described as family-friendly, with refreshments and activities at the start and finish, as well as changing facilities and showers at the IKHP cabin.

name: Broloppet Motala

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Priser fram till 28/9 (nästa höjning) - passa på!

description: Broloppet Motala is a popular running race organized by Motala AIF Friidrott, with the start and finish in Stadsparken in Motala. The race features a newly revived course that runs through central Motala, offering a pleasant running experience in an urban setting. There are two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with a separate lane for runners completing the first lap of the 10 km race. Water stations are available at the bridge and at the lap point to provide runners with the best possible support.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken, in central Motala
Newly revived course through the city centre
Water stations at the bridge (approx. 3 km) and at the lap point
additional: Late registration is available on race day, 3/10, from 10:00 to 12:30 at Team Sportia. Bib numbers can be collected at Team Sportia from Friday 2/10, 10:00–18:00, and Saturday 3/10, 10:00–12:30. Changing facilities are available at Actic Stora Torget. Bag drop-off is by the stage. The 10 km race has a separate lane for runners completing the first lap.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a unique race held only once, giving participants the opportunity to run or walk on the new E4 between Hjulsta and Häggvik, both above and below ground. The race offers different classes and distances for all levels, from walking to racing, with the start and finish at the new Akalla interchange in Stockholm. It’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience where you get to be the first to set foot on the new road before it opens to traffic.
course_highlights: The race runs both above and below ground on the new E4 Förbifart Stockholm
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange
In the recreational class, you can choose an exit after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km
additional: Race bibs are either mailed to participants’ homes or collected on site, depending on the participant’s address. The competitive class starts at 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and the walking class Herr Gårman starts between 18:00 and 19:30. The maximum time for the competitive class is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Entry is personal and cannot be transferred. The event area is easiest to reach by metro to Akalla.

name: Botaniczna Piątka - edycja jesienna
location: Botaniczna Piątka, Ogród Botaniczny w Kielcach, Kielce, Poland

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
location: Villands Vånga, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Vånga Mountain Xtreme is a challenging trail race offering three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 40 km, with 300, 600 and 1,500 metres of elevation gain respectively. The races take place in a wilderness setting, with winding trails, small tarns and deep quarries, and feature beautiful views and demanding hills. Participants get to experience the different sides of Vångaberget, with the longest distance taking runners up the mountain five times. FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to a memorable and demanding trail-running experience in Villands Vånga.
course_highlights: Winding trails in untouched wilderness
Beautiful views by small tarns and deep quarries
Challenging climbs: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Late registration is available on site until approximately one hour before the start, with payment via Swish. There is also a children’s race, VMX Kids, with free on-site registration. The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation. Transfer of a race entry is possible under the terms listed on the website. The listed distances are 8, 16 and 40 km, plus VMX Kids. Trail running shoes are recommended. The website describes the 2026 edition and does not confirm details for 2027.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: Türi Tehisjärve jooks on osa 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksude sarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele. Rada kulgeb ümber Rava tehisjärve, pakkudes vaheldusrikast pinnast liivast, mullast ja kruusast. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid jooksjaid ning see sobib nii harrastajatele kui ka noortele jooksusõpradele. Üritus toimub 7. oktoobril 2026 Rava järve ääres Järvamaal.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
description: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, skirtas populiarinti bėgimą, dviračių sportą ir orientavimąsi gamtoje. Varžybos vyksta Ukmergėje, o dalyviai varžosi bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo rungtyse. Renginys skatina aktyvų laisvalaikį įvairaus amžiaus žmonėms ir jaunimo domėjimąsi sportu. Varžybų startas vyksta Šilo pagrindinės mokyklos stadione, o laiko limitas yra 120 minučių (išskyrus Mini Rogainingą).

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė 2026 yra penkių etapų sporto renginys, apimantis bėgimo kroso, MTB dviračių kroso ir rogainingo varžybas. Renginys vyksta Kopūstėlių miške Ukmergėje ir skirtas skatinti aktyvų laisvalaikį gamtoje bei populiarinti sportą įvairaus amžiaus dalyvių tarpe. Varžybų startas yra bendras visoms grupėms ir vyksta vakare, o dalyviai varžosi pagal amžiaus grupes ir rungčių tipus. Pagrindinis organizatorius yra VšĮ Sportas miške, o renginys remiamas kelių Ukmergės įmonių.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026 yra pirmasis maratonas, organizuojamas Kaišiadoryse, kuris vyks 2026 m. spalio 10 d. Šis renginys žymi naują tradiciją, suburiantį bėgikus iš Lietuvos ir užsienio. Maratonas vyks aktyviame ir sportiškame mieste, kuris garsėja savo sporto renginiais ir aktyviu gyvenimo būdu. Renginį organizuoja BK „Kaišiadorys bėga“, Kaišiadorių rajono savivaldybė, Kaišiadorių švietimo ir sporto centras bei VšĮ „Maratomanija“.

name: Bėgimas Gintarinė jūrmylė
organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”
description: „Gintarinė jūrmylė“ yra tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos, vykstančios nuostabioje Smiltynėje. Renginys siūlo įvairius nuotolius: 0,5 jūrmylės vaikams, 1 jūrmylę visiems norintiems, 3 jūrmyles moterims ir 6 jūrmyles vyrams bei profesionalams. Startas ir finišas yra Sporto sveikatingumo bazėje, o dalyviai vaišinami kareiviška koše ir arbata. Varžybų tradicija įamžina nugalėtojų vardus atminimo akmenyje, iškeltame iš marių dugno.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
description: 42. Munamäe - Võru maastikujooks-kõnd on osa Võrumaa jooksu- ja kõnnisarjast, mis pakub mitmekesiseid distantsivalikuid nii jooksjatele kui ka kõndijatele. Põhidistants kulgeb maastikul ja asfaltteedel, pakkudes vaheldusrikast rada Võru piirkonnas. Sarjas on ka lühemad distantsid ning mudilaste jooksud, mis sobivad igas vanuses osalejatele. Võistlus toimub SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaasis Kubijal, mis on tuntud oma kauni looduse ja hea rajatingimuste poolest.

name: Ultunamilen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Gratis för medlemmar i Upsala IF Friidrott

description: For many years, Ultunamilen was organized by Upsala IF, but in 2026 it will be replaced by Gränbyloppet, held in Gränbyparken in Uppsala. Gränbyloppet focuses on the joy of running and safety in the area, with the start and finish near IFU Arena. The race is part of Terrängserien and offers several categories and distances for young people and adults, on a course that runs through the park and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the intersection northeast of the pergola in Gränbyparken
Course in Gränbyparken with 2.5 km laps (blue course)
The race is held alongside the final event of Terrängserien
additional: All participants must wear a visible race number. The nearest parking is at Gränbystaden. The final day of Terrängserien is held alongside Gränbyloppet for young people aged 14 and under. Results are published around the time of the race.

name: Skrylle Challenge
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-focused race organised by Björnstorps IF, starting and finishing at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organisers are introducing a new, more trail-focused loop course, with a choice of one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a nature-close and challenging experience on the area’s best trails, and information will be updated throughout the spring. Early-bird places are available, and there is also a 600 m children’s race.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is a running race in Bromölla organized by Ryssbergets IK. The event offers 10 km and 5 km distances, with the start and finish at Sparbankshallen. The course is well marked, and officials are on hand to guide runners. Water stations with water and sports drink are available at the lap point and finish. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and refreshments including coffee and grilled sausages.
course_highlights: The course is marked at every kilometre with arrows, lines and tape
Water stations with water and sports drink at the lap point and finish
Start and finish at Sparbankshallen in Bromölla
additional: Race bibs must be collected from Sparbankshallen no later than 30 minutes before the start and worn on the front of the chest. Officials are positioned at intersections to provide guidance. Online registration is closed; late registration is available on site. The awards ceremony begins at 12:30. Medical staff are available in the start/finish area. Refreshments including coffee and grilled sausages are available after the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race is organised by the Mental Health Run association, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Maritime Museum, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone should be able to take part, regardless of their background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run on kymmenennen kerran järjestettävä polkujuoksutapahtuma, joka kutsuu juoksijat kokemaan Porvoon upeimmat polut ja merelliset maisemat lokakuun raikkaudessa. Tapahtuma tarjoaa monipuolisia reittivaihtoehtoja kaiken kuntoisille, aina 2 km lasten Polkurallista aina 42 km polkujuoksuun. Kisapäivä alkaa lasten Polkurallilla ja jatkuu useilla eri matkoilla, jotka kiertävät kauniita ja vaihtelevia polkuja Porvoon alueella. Osallistumismaksu sisältää monipuoliset palvelut ja tapahtuman aikana otetaan valokuva- ja videomateriaalia, jota käytetään tapahtuman tiedottamisessa.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari on traditsiooniline jooksu- ja kõnnisari, mis pakub mitmekesiseid jooksuvõimalusi erinevatele vanuseklassidele ja tasemetele. Sarja etapid toimuvad Lääne-Virumaa piirkonnas, pakkudes jooksjatele kauneid maastikke ja meeldivat sportlikku kogemust. Võsu Sügisjooks on sarja 7. etapp, mis toimub Võsu Laine piirkonnas ning on osa pika traditsiooniga jooksusarjast. Sarja eesmärk on motiveerida inimesi aktiivselt liikuma ja nautima jooksu ning tervisesporti.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: Viljandi Linnajooks on traditsiooniline kestvusjooks, mis toimub igal aastal oktoobrikuu teisel pühapäeval Viljandi linnas. Jooks kulgeb ümber Viljandi järve ning on üks Eesti vanimaid spordivõistlusi, kuhu koguneb jooksuparemik üle kogu riigi. Lisaks põhijooksule toimub mitmeid rahvaspordiüritusi, sealhulgas lastejooksud erinevatele vanusegruppidele. Viljandi Linnajooksu rada on 10,4 km pikkune ning üritus pakub sportlikku ja meeleolukat kogemust nii harrastajatele kui ka profisportlastele.

name: Piwna Mila
description: Piwna Mila to wyjątkowy bieg na dystansie elastycznym od 1700 do 2000 metrów, będący najważniejszym wydarzeniem trzeciego dnia Festiwalu Słońca w Wąsowie. Uczestnicy startują, wypijając jedno piwo, a na trasie co około 500 metrów znajdują się punkty odżywiania z piwem. To sportowe święto łączy biegaczy, kibiców i całe rodziny, oferując niepowtarzalną atmosferę i wyjątkowy medal za ukończenie biegu.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: Bieg Przyjaźni to jedna z imprez w ramach cyklu Kaszuby Biegają, największej imprezy biegowej północnej Polski. Zawody odbywają się w malowniczej okolicy Skrzeszewa, oferując uczestnikom możliwość aktywnego spędzenia czasu i poznania uroków Kaszub. Cykl biegów przyciąga biegaczy w różnym wieku i o różnym stopniu zaawansowania, promując zdrowy styl życia i integrację lokalnej społeczności.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 175 kr och höjs den 1 oktober till 220 kr.

description: Hässelbyloppet is a classic 10 km race held in northwest Stockholm, featuring a flat, fast course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby. The race has a long tradition and is organised by Hässelby SK Friidrott. The same day, Lilla Hässelbyloppet is also held, a race for children and young people with shorter distances. The course is officially measured, and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. It is a festive event celebrating the joy of running and great performances in a welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Lilla Hässelbyloppet, with shorter distances for children and young people
The course is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: Lilla Hässelbyloppet is provisionally scheduled to start at 11:00, and Hässelbyloppet at 12:00. Hässelby Idrottsplats is the event hub, close to the metro. Pacers are available for times between 37:30 and 60 minutes. Race bibs can be collected the day before the race. Drinks and snacks are provided after the finish. Timing is available from age 9, and results are published on the website.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra on ultramaratonjuoksutapahtuma, jossa kilpailijat juoksevat 6,706 kilometrin kierroksia tunnin sisällä niin kauan kuin useat juoksijat pystyvät jatkamaan. Kilpailu on ainutlaatuinen, koska sillä ei ole ennalta määrättyä loppuaikaa tai -matkaa, ja voittaja on se, joka juoksee yhden kierroksen enemmän kuin muut. Tapahtuma järjestetään Polku-hotellissa Vihtissä ja tarjoaa haastetta sitkeydestä ja kestävyyttä arvostaville juoksijoille. Kilpailun juuret ovat Yhdysvalloissa, ja se tunnetaan myös nimellä "Just one more Loop".

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail races focused on the experience of light and darkness meeting. You can choose 5 km, 10 km or 30 km, starting and finishing at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km distance, you navigate using a downloadable GPS route and map, and there are energy stations along the way. Sign up— all proceeds go to youth sports in Attunda Orienteringsklubb.

name: 53. Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks
description: Saaremaa kolme päeva jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus Kuressaares, mis kutsub osalema kõiki jooksusõpru. Võistlus hõlmab mitmeid distantsivalikuid ja vanusegruppe, pakkudes võimalust nii noortele kui täiskasvanutele. Registreerimine toimub kohapeal ning osavõtumaks on taskukohane, mis teeb selle ürituse ligipääsetavaks laiale osalejate ringile. Võistlus on osa suuremast jooksusarjast, kus arvestatakse ka hooaja kokkuvõtteid ja autasustamist.

name: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas
description: Backyard Ultra Pasaulio čempionatas yra unikalus bekelės bėgimo renginys, kuriame bėgikai kas valandą turi įveikti 6,7 km ratą tol, kol lieka paskutinis stovintis. Varžybos vyksta kalnuotose ir bekelės trasose, kurios reikalauja ištvermės ir valios. Renginys yra iššūkis tiek fizinei, tiek psichologinei ištvermei, o nugalėtojas visada yra tik vienas. Trailo Kalvė organizuoja šį renginį su ypatingu dėmesiu trasų kokybei ir dalyvių patirčiai, kviesdama bėgikus išbandyti save ir įveikti save pačius.

name: XII Pagarbos/Paramos bėgimas „IN MEMORIAM“, skirtas šiais metais mirusiems kariams atminti
organizer: Lietuvos didžiosios kunigaikštienės Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų organizacija
description: Pagarbos ir paramos bėgimas „In Memoriam“ Vilniuje yra iškilus renginys, skirtas pagerbti šiais metais mirusius Lietuvos kariuomenės karius ir paremti jų šeimas. Renginys vyksta Vingio parke ir apima 1 km bei 4 km distancijas be varžybų, taip pat 10 km atvirą Lietuvos kariuomenės bėgimo čempionatą. Bėgimas gimė kaip jautri iniciatyva atminti jauną karininką ir tapo svarbia kasmetine pilietine bei patriotine tradicija. Organizuoja LDK Birutės karininkų šeimų moterų sąjunga kartu su Krašto apsaugos ministerija ir Lietuvos kariuomene.

name: Trail Kursiu Nerija #TKN
description: Trail Kuršių Nerija #TKN yra nuostabus bėgimas gamtos takais Kuršių Nerijoje, Lietuvoje, siūlantis įvairius distancijų pasirinkimus nuo vaikų 1 km trasos iki ekstremalių 104 km. Renginys žavi dalyvius savo nepakartojamais vaizdais, smėlio takais ir galimybe bėgti ar eiti pagal savo tempą. Tai puiki proga patirti gamtos grožį ir aktyviai praleisti laiką su šeima ar draugais. Renginys yra draugiškas visiems bėgimo lygiams ir amžiaus grupėms.

name: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė
description: Bėgimas Graužikai-Kelmė yra tradicinis Kelmės rajono bėgimas, skirtas Vaidoto Rimkaus atminimui. Varžybos vyksta spalio mėnesį ir siekia populiarinti bėgimą bei lengvąją atletiką Lietuvoje, skatinti sveiką gyvenimo būdą ir didinti rajono gyventojų aktyvumą. Renginys pritraukia įvairaus amžiaus bėgikus, o dalyviai gali rinktis iš kelių distancijų, įskaitant 8 km pagrindinį bėgimą. Varžybų metu dalyviai apdovanojami taurėmis, medaliais ir atminimo prizais.

name: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks
description: Saaremaa Kolme Päeva Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Iide külas. Võistlus koosneb kolmest etapist, kus osalejad saavad nautida Saaremaa kaunist loodust ja mitmekesist maastikku. Võistlus on avatud erinevatele vanusegruppidele ning pakub sõbralikku ja toetavat atmosfääri kõigile jooksuhuvilistele. Osalejatele on tagatud elektrooniline ajavõtt, korduvkasutatavad rinnanumbrid ja joogitopsid ning pärast jooksu magus amps ja jook.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na doskonałe bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® to cykl biegów trailowych odbywających się na pagórkowatych szlakach Pomorza i Kaszub, z bazą zawodów w KJ Barłomino. W ramach imprezy dostępnych jest pięć dystansów: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km oraz 11 km, oferujących różnorodne wyzwania dla biegaczy terenowych. Zawody promują piękno kaszubskich terenów oraz regionalne atrakcje, a uczestnicy mogą liczyć na dobrze przygotowane bufety na trasie. Impreza jest wspierana przez program #AktywnaWieś i organizowana przez Stowarzyszenie Pomerania Sports.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The races pass through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills along scenic trails and roads, with short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. The youngest runners have a relatively flat course, and the event is designed as an enjoyable day with music, refreshments and award ceremonies. It is presented as a local, friendly family race with plenty of parking and cycling options.

name: Åhus TrailRun
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal woodlands and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The gently undulating courses combine trails, sand dunes, varied terrain and running on sand along the coast—guaranteeing participants an exceptional running experience. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also features team competitions. The maximum number of participants is 1,000.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a fun race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) options are available, and the organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45, and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.

name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of running in the dark. Dog Trail is a special category where you can share the evening with your dog over 5 km or 10 km, on courses designed for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasizes safety in the dark—the courses are marked with reflective markers, and a headlamp is required. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholms Brantaste is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, taking place on 17 October 2026. The race is just over 3–3.5 km long, with a steep climb and more than 200 metres of elevation gain, and is aimed at both experienced runners and beginners who want to challenge themselves. The finish is at the top of the hill, with a beautiful view over the city. The children’s races Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta are also offered, but registration for these may be closed at certain times.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal where each lap is 6.706 metres. The format features hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start every full hour, for a total of up to 12 laps. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories is the participant who completes the most laps, with the fastest time on the final lap breaking a tie. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical yet runnable course through scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate start time in the afternoon.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organised by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people who are a little adventurous and interested in fitness, and places as much emphasis on the experience of nature as on performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through hilly terrain close to nature.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://baueractivities.se/loppen/vistakulle-backyard/): 2026-10-17 — "17 Oktober 2026 07.00-19.00" (was estimated 2027-05-15)

name: Krusensterni jooks
description: Krusensterni Jooks on traditsiooniline jooksuvõistlus, mis toimub Purila bussipeatusest startides ja Hagudi mõisas finišeerides. Jooksu pikkus on 4,2 km ning see sobib nii õpilastele, pensionäridele kui ka täiskasvanutele. Võistlusel autasustatakse parimaid mehi ja naisi ning eriauhindu saavad veteraniklassi sportlased, noorim ja vanim lõpetaja ning suurim pere. Osavõtt toimub omal riisikol ning kõigile lõpetajatele pakutakse vett, maiustust ja kuuma teed.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon in scenic surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Castle. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a finish back by the sea with views towards Bogesundlandet. The course is officially measured and the race is organized by Täby IS Friidrott. It is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and beautiful course. The race has been very popular in previous years, with limited places, so the organizers encourage early registration.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen—perhaps autumn’s fastest officially measured 10K, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course runs entirely on cycle paths and footpaths and is fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for those chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates a sum to the Swedish Childhood Cancer Fund for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top 3 in both the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.

name: Pukinmaki Run Helsinki 18.10.2026
description: Pukinmäki Run on vuosittain Helsingissä Pukinmäen kaupunginosassa järjestettävä juoksutapahtuma, joka tarjoaa matkoja 1 km lapsille, 5 km, 10 km ja puolimaratonin. Reitti on tasainen ja nopea, pääosin asfalttia ja ulkoiluteitä, ja se kiertää Pukinmäen rajoja. Tapahtuma on avoin kaikenikäisille ja -tasoisille juoksijoille, ja se tarjoaa mahdollisuuden nauttia liikunnasta ja kauniista luonnosta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Kisakeskus sijaitsee Pukinmäen urheilupuistossa, ja tapahtumassa on tarjolla virvokkeita ja välipaloja.

name: Emili jookseb
description: Emili jookseb on sügisesel ajal Kadrioru pargis toimuv rõõmsameelne koolipere jooksuüritus, kus osalevad nii õpilased, õpetajad kui ka lapsevanemad. Ürituse fookus on liikumisrõõmul ja üksteise toetamisel, mitte kiirusel. See traditsiooniline sündmus loob ühtehoidvustunnet ja pakub kogukonnale meeldivaid liikumishetki värskes õhus. Esimene jooks toimus kuldsete lehtede keskel ja oli inspireeriv algus koolivaheajale.

name: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks
location: Holstre-Polli Sports Centre, Holstre, Viljandi County, Estonia
description: 3. Holstre-Polli ööjooks toimub Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse tervise- ja suusaradadel Viljandimaal. See öine jooks pakub osalejatele võimalust kogeda metsikut loodust ja rahu, mis ümbritseb spordikeskust. Üritus on osa Holstre-Polli Spordikeskuse spordisündmuste sarjast ning sobib nii kogenud jooksjatele kui ka harrastajatele. Osalejatel on võimalik nautida unikaalset öist jooksukogemust kauni looduse keskel.

name: Sporto šventė Juodšilių ruduo
location: Juodšilių, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The “Juodšilių ruduo” sports festival is a Vilnius District sporting event taking place on October 24, 2026, in Juodšiliai. The event encourages community members to take part in sports, promotes athletics and running, and advocates a healthy lifestyle. Anyone may participate, with distances of 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km. Participants register and collect their bibs at the event venue from 10:00 to 11:30. Participation is voluntary, and runners are responsible for their own health.
course_highlights: The course is in the territory of Juodšiliai Eldership, Vilnius District
Events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km cross-country runs
Walking animals and using personal support during the event are prohibited
additional: Bib collection and registration take place from 10:00 to 11:30. Participants must present an identity document to collect their bib. Participants may not transfer their bib to another person, use personal support, walk animals on the course, or leave the course without a judge’s permission. Protests must be submitted in writing within 30 minutes after the end of the event, with a fee of 30 EUR. The fee for changing an event is 6 EUR; changing to a longer event requires payment of the difference. Running events: 600 m, 4 km, and 12 km; registration from 10:00 to 11:30; participant awards and commemorative medals; participant restrictions and rules.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: VSM terräng
description: The 2026 Swedish Cross Country Championships are organized by Västerås Friidrott and will be held at Rocklunda IP in Västerås on October 24–25. The course is an easy-to-run cross-country course over a flat grassy area, with a 2–3-meter-wide gravel path that is crossed several times per lap. Hay bales are used as obstacles on parts of the course. The event welcomes runners of different ages and abilities and offers ample parking, as well as nearby accommodation and lunch service at Good Morning Hotels.
course_highlights: Flat grassy area with less than 0.5 meters of elevation difference
2–3-meter-wide gravel path crossed four times per lap
Hay bale obstacles on parts of the course
additional: Pre-booked lunch is served at Good Morning Hotels, 700 meters from the venue, on Saturday and Sunday for 130 SEK. Book lunch by emailing henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se no later than October 16. Plenty of free parking is available next to the competition area. The VSM categories start on Saturday, October 24; the first start is at 10:30 a.m. Free parking is available next to the competition area. Pre-booked lunch is available for 130 SEK.

name: Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail
description: Welcome to the second edition of Linghem Dark Halfyard (Ultra) Trail, a unique and exciting running event in the autumn darkness of Kråksångsskogen. The race consists of 13 laps on a 3.5 km loop, with each lap to be completed in no more than 30 minutes. After the sixth lap, runners change direction, adding an extra dimension to the competition. A headlamp is mandatory, as almost the entire race takes place in darkness. This is a small-scale race with a limited number of places, offering a challenge for anyone looking to test their limits in ultrarunning.
course_highlights: 13 laps of a 3.5 km loop, with a maximum of 30 minutes per lap
Change of running direction after the sixth lap
The course is marked with reflectors and trail markers, and consists mostly of trails with around 700 metres of gravel
additional: Food and energy are provided during laps 7 and 8 (pizza from a local pizzeria), as well as sweets, bananas, crisps, coffee, hot broth, sports drink and water. Facilities are limited, with self-service energy, a warm fire and shelter from the elements. Toilets are in the woods. Maximum 70 places. Each lap starts every 30 minutes, and if you complete a lap faster, you can rest for the remaining time before the next lap starts. The race starts at the Linghemsskogen barbecue area. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes. A headlamp and mobile phone are mandatory items of equipment. Limited to 70 places; registration closes on 13 October. Participants who complete at least one lap receive a wooden medal.

name: Halloween Night Trail
description: Halloween Night Trail is an exciting and atmospheric trail race in the dark at the Karlsnäs area north of Ronneby. The race offers three distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The courses are marked with reflectors and torches to guide runners through the darkness. After crossing the finish line, all participants are served a grilled hamburger and a drink, making for a pleasant end to the evening. The event has a Halloween theme, with decorations along the course, and encourages participants to dress up for an extra festive atmosphere. Ronneby Orienteering Club is the experienced race organiser.
course_highlights: Run on narrow trails and through terrain, with reflectors showing the way in the dark
Halloween-themed features such as Zombie Hill, Count Dracula’s lair and the Bat Cave
The finish area is indoors, and grilled hamburgers and drinks are served after the race
additional: Electronic timing for the 5 km and 10 km distances; no timing for the 2 km. Race bibs and chips can be collected at the venue from 17:00. A headlamp is recommended to help you follow the reflectors in the dark. The prize ceremony is tentatively scheduled for 20:45. Changing rooms and showers are available in limited numbers. Extra hamburgers can be purchased after the race. Parents may run with children in the 2 km without registering. Shoes with good grip are recommended because the surfaces may be wet and slippery. Electronic timing is provided for the 5 km and 10 km, but not the 2 km. A hamburger and a small drink are included in the entry fee. The venue and finish are at Friluftscentrum Karlsnäsgården.

name: Bėgimas „Aplink Lietuvą“
description: The “Around Lithuania” Run is a traditional running event held in Rumšiškės, on the grounds of the Lithuanian Open-Air Museum. The event offers a range of distances, from a 300 m children’s race to the 21.098 km half marathon, which is the main event and counts toward the Lithuanian Running Cup standings. Participants start according to age-group handicap rules, and the event program includes registration, starts for different distances, and awards. It is a great opportunity to spend time actively outdoors and compete with running enthusiasts from all over Lithuania.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 300 m children’s race to a 21.098 km half marathon
Starts follow age-group handicap rules
Location: Lithuanian Open-Air Museum in Rumšiškės
additional: Event program: 09:00 registration and race number distribution, 10:45 competition opening, starts for different distances from 11:00 to 13:00, awards from 14:00. The main distance is 21.098 km, consisting of 4 laps. The age-group handicap system allows less competitive participants to start earlier. The event takes place in Rumšiškės, with online registration available. The program includes starts, awards, and special groups.

name: Pärnu Rannajooks
description: Pärnu Beach Run is the season-ending race and final event in the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. It takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The course runs through the beautiful Pärnu beach area, offering natural scenery and architectural landmarks characteristic of the city, including the seaside promenade. The event is suitable for recreational and experienced runners alike and offers an enjoyable sporting experience.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances, available for running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles
Course through Pärnu’s beach area, with beautiful natural scenery and architectural landmarks
Seaside promenade with views of the sea
additional: The distance options are 5 km and 10 km, which can be completed by running or walking with or without Nordic walking poles. The race is part of the Pärnu Two Bridges Club’s three-event series. Children’s races and virtual race distances are also planned. The event includes virtual races and children’s races and takes place at Pärnu Beach Stadium, offering a chance to enjoy sport and nature together.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night marathon and half marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nighttime ambience. The course consists of laps of approximately 7 kilometres, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has official PZLA certification, which verifies the course distance and makes it possible to set world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners who want to improve their personal bests in the one-of-a-kind conditions of a night race.
course_highlights: The course consists of laps of approximately 7 km, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirms the course distance
Views of the stadium along the course and Koszalin’s undulating terrain
additional: The race office for children and young people opens at around 19:00, with a limited number of places (20). The race office for adults is located in the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at ul. Racławicka, about 300 m from the stadium, and remains open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants must show a photo ID when collecting their race number. The course runs along the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. The medal and merchandise are updated each year and are an important part of the event. The event offers different distances, including a marathon and half marathon, with reports, photo and video galleries, and options to register online or at the race office. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the chance to compete in various themed categories.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Run along the Lower Vistula Valley Trail is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two distances: a certified 42.195 km marathon and an uncertified 21.097 km half marathon. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Vistula Valley and feature a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00, and the half marathon starts in Małe Walichnowy at 11:00. Both finish in Tczew.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The route is marked every 1 km with painted markings and yellow signs
additional: The limit is 400 paid participants. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon route is PZLA-certified; the half marathon is not. The finish is at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes have varied surfaces. The participant limit is 400, registration is online, and the event includes a half marathon and a marathon.

name: 63 Bieg Republiki Ostrowskiej
location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: II Jesienny Bieg Charytatywny Artbud Group – Biegniemy dla Rodzin Zastępczych
XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza
Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja jesienna 2026
location: Ogród Dendrologiczny w Przelewicach, Przelewice, Poland

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Löfstad Slott Trail
description: Löfstad Slott Trail is an atmospheric trail race held in the autumn darkness around historic Löfstad Castle in Norrköping. The event offers two distances: Lilla Skymningsloppet, a 1,000-metre children’s race in the park, and Löfstads Mörkaste, a 7-kilometre night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain, where a headlamp is mandatory. The course winds through the beautiful castle park and forest and is marked with reflectors and tape for a safe and memorable running experience. Löfstad Slott Trail is a perfect start to the autumn holiday week and is organised by Orienteringsklubben Denseln, with a focus on community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 7 km night race on gravel roads, trails and unmarked forest terrain
The course is marked with reflectors and tape
1,000-metre children’s race in the park, with no timing
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 15:00 in the castle courtyard. On-site registration is available. Parking is available up to 500 metres from the castle; allow extra time to walk. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and a headlamp is mandatory. Trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet is not timed, and children may run with an adult without registering separately. All participants receive a prize at the finish, and special prizes are awarded after the race. Löfstads Mörkaste starts at 17:00 and requires a headlamp; trail shoes are recommended. Lilla Skymningsloppet starts at 16:00 and is not timed. Participants under 15 in the 7 km race must run with a registered responsible adult.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė 5 etapas
description: On the evening of August 21, the Jonava Sports Center invited running enthusiasts to the fourth stage of the Jonava Running Cup. This time, participants took on a scenic 7 km course in the village of Panoteriai. This August was a special one for the village, marking the 115th anniversary of Panoteriai School and the 30th anniversary of the consecration of the Church of the Discovery of the Holy Cross. Although heavy rain accompanied the runners, it did not dampen the festive atmosphere—the awards ceremony was held inside the Panoteriai church.

images.alt_text: Bėgikai prie starto linijos, pasiruošę bėgimui. Matomas laiko matuoklis ir bėgikų numeriai.
Bėgikų grupė Jonavos bėgimo taurės varžybose, kelių lenktynės.
Bėgimo lenktynės su daug bėgikų prie starto linijos, laukiantys starto.
Bėgikai po lenktynių su LBMA ir Bėgimo klubo vėliava.

name: Bėgam už Kalvarijos XI
description: Let’s Run for Kalvarija — a road race through the city streets, taking place on Sodų St., Klimo St., Dariaus ir Girėno St. and Laisvės St. The start and finish are by the Independence Monument on Laisvės St.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo lenktynės Kalvarijoje žiemos metu. Bėgikai bėga snieguotu keliu.
Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Kalvarijos gatvių bėgime.
Kalvarijos Nepriklausomybės paminklas, bėgimo starto ir finišo vieta.

name: Juozo Songailos Run
description: September 15, 2024.!!! Mark this day on your calendar!!! This is an event where we will celebrate the long sporting career of Juozas Songaila, Ukmergė’s most famous runner! You can choose from the following distances: running—a marathon, half marathon, 7 km, 3 km, and 400 m (children’s race); Nordic walking—a half marathon and 7 km. Every participant who completes their distance will receive a wonderfully beautiful, one-of-a-kind medal!

images.alt_text: Juozo Songailos 70-mečio bėgimo renginio plakatas su bėgiku.
Du vyrai su medaliu Juozo Songailos bėgimo proga. Fone matomas renginio pavadinimas.
Bėgikas bėga per rūką, apšviestas mėlyna šviesa, atrodo kaip kliūčių ruožas.
Juozas Songaila su trofėjumi, bėgimo entuziastas ir sveikos gyvensenos propaguotojas.

name: Bėgimas Kaune
description: The annual pink ribbon charity run in Kaunas supports breast cancer prevention. It is a short, recreational and fun running course—a joyful, positive celebration of sport decorated with pink costumes, paint, balloons and ribbons. During PINK RUN, both men and women can show their support and love for the women closest to them: their mother, daughter, sister, wife or best friend.

images.alt_text: Rožinis bėgimas Kaune: didelis žmonių būrys rožiniais marškinėliais, scena ir renginio atmosfera.
Rožinis kaspinas ant džinsinio audinio, simbolizuojantis kovą su krūties vėžiu.
Moteris su rožiniu megztiniu ir krepšiu su abstrakčiu piešiniu, skirtu krūties vėžio prevencijai.

name: Molėtai Bėga
description: Molėtai Sports Center together with the Lithuanian Amateur Running Association invites you to the traditional “Molėtai Runs 2024” race, held for the fourth time, on October 20, 2024. The race distances include 3 km (girls/boys, born in 2006 or later), 9 km (women/men, ages 19–44 and 45 and over), and a 400 m course with no age restrictions. The event brings together running enthusiasts and offers the opportunity to participate in various age groups.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo apdovanojimų ceremonija: vyras su taure, ant kurios bėgikų siluetai.
Bėgimo varžybos mieste, matomos pro langą.

name: Vilniaus maratonas
description: The „Rimi“ Vilnius Marathon, taking place on September 8, 2024, will start for the 22nd time in Vilnius, at Cathedral Square. It is Lithuania’s largest running event, attracting professional runners and enthusiasts from across the country and abroad. Participants can choose from a range of distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a 200 m children’s race.

images.alt_text: Bėgikai prie starto linijos „Rimi Vilniaus maratonas“.
Vilniaus maratono bėgimas, finišo linija, bėgikai.
Rimi Vilniaus maratonas logo, 2024 rugsėjo 8 d.

name: Greičio Ratai
description: Public Institution Nesustabdomas bėgimas (Volvere run running club), together with the Sports Events Association, is organizing 60 m, 1000 m, and 5×1000 m relay races on September 19, 2025, at Vingis Park Stadium. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to test themselves over various distances and enjoy the spirit of sport.

images.alt_text: Bėgikai starto pozicijoje ant bėgimo takelio.

name: SPORTLAND KÕRVEMAA METSAJOOKS  27. SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Why take part in the Kõrvemaa Forest Run?

- Probably the most beautiful trails, surrounded by unspoilt nature.
- 100% of the course is in a stunning nature reserve.
- Give your body and mind a boost.
- Bring the whole family: activities and childcare are organised for the little ones, too.
- A convenient, compact event centre close to Tallinn.
- Free soup, a smoothie and other surprises from our partners for everyone.
- Of course, there’ll also be a hot sauna and, for the bolder participants, a hot tub.
- You can also take part with your whole work team to boost team spirit and health.
- Together, we’re helping improve public health in Estonia.

The Sportland pop-up shop will be open all day, so you can top up your running gear if you’ve forgotten something at home or want the best functional gear for the course. Every finisher will receive a great medal, a GRAM drink and a Nicks bar. Winners will receive Sportland credit, a sapling and gifts from our partners. The season’s best in each age group and the season’s best team will also be recognised.

Want to enjoy a private sauna with your group? Rent the Iglusaun by the pond! Would you like to stay overnight in Kõrvemaa? Check availability at Kuuse Elamusmajad.
course_highlights: 100% of the course runs through a stunning nature reserve
Trail running in unspoilt nature, with a mix of climbs and descents
Routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike
additional:
Register online at iseteenindus.sportlandkorvemaa.ee or through the Sportos platform, where Stebby is also available as a payment method.

The event takes place on Sunday, 27.09.2026. On race day, you can register at the start venue from 10.00. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start.

Seniors (aged 60+) and young people (aged up to 17) receive a 50% discount on the main distances when registering in advance. The discount is applied automatically during registration based on year of birth. The minimum discounted price is 15 EUR; the discount will not reduce the price below this amount. The discount does not apply to youth races, which already have a special price of 15 EUR. Only one discount can be used at a time; the system always applies the larger discount.

A 10% discount applies when registering at least 5 people together. A 20% discount applies when registering at least 10 people together. If you are registering from the same company, club or group of friends, be sure to enter your team name, as we will award the best team to take part in the series at the end of the season.

name: Swedbanki Tallinna Maraton
description:
Swedbank Tallinn Marathon and Tallinn Autumn Run invite you to register!

Estonia’s largest running and movement festival, the Swedbank Tallinn Marathon, takes place from September 11 to 13. The programme of this event, which brings together thousands of active people, includes the classic marathon (42.195 km) and marathon relay, half marathon (21.1 km), Tallinn Autumn Run (10 km), Nike Youth Run (5 km), Welcome Run and Limpa Kids’ Runs.

The Tallinn Marathon’s event centre and start-finish area are located on the edge of Tallinn’s Old Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The course runs along streets and cycle and pedestrian paths, passing interesting places and offering a colourful overview of Estonia’s capital.

Over the years, more than 340,000 active people have taken part in the Tallinn Marathon across its various distances. The record for international participants at Estonia’s largest sporting event by number of participants was set in 2025, when runners came from as many as 93 countries.

Take this opportunity to be part of Estonia’s most spectacular movement event!

name: I Bieg NIEUCHWYTNI – Bieg Charytatywny dla Fundacji Podkarpackie Hospicjum dla Dzieci
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Szlachta Biega, Klub Sportowy Ultra Sp. z.o.o. oraz MOSiR Łańcut.
description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

The 5 km race will feature overall classifications for women and men, as well as age-group categories. There will also be a special classification for the fastest female and male residents of the Municipality of Jabłonna Lacka.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: Cross Rosłon Kabaty
description: A cross-country race in Kabaty in Powsin Culture Park, dedicated to the memory of coach Sławomir Rosłoń
additional: Powsin Culture Park – Kabaty Forest; start/finish and race office near the campfire clearing

name: Höstmilen
description: Höstmilen is a trail race in the Kolmården forests outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on 1 November 2026. The course follows trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic, challenging terrain for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The event is organised by OK Kolmården and has three main race options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, and races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running through the scenic, hilly terrain of the Kolmården forests
additional: Online registration closes on 29 October at 23:00; after that, it is possible to register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus runs from Jurslaskolan to the start at Sörsjön. The race information sheet will be published approximately one week before the event. The adult races have just two prize categories: Men and Women. A complete list of registered participants will be published on the “Registered” page. Distances and competition formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team, company and school competitions. The Höstmilen race information sheet and registration are available via hostmilen.nu.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was founded in 2015 and can be described as a recreational race where nature, camaraderie and the experience take centre stage, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers all runners, regardless of ability, a fantastic opportunity to take part in one of three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail) and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has 500 metres of elevation gain.

name: Uddloppet
description:
Uddloppet is a spring race in Karlshamn, Blekinge, for both recreational and elite runners. It’s a perfect start to the running season and a great way to check your fitness after winter training.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Distances:
4 km (09:45)
10 km (11:00)
Half marathon (11:00)
Children’s race, 400 m (10:30)
Walking class, 2.5 km (between 09:00 and 13:00)

Course: A scenic, gently hilly route along the sea and through the forest east of Karlshamn. Start and finish at Vägga sports ground.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Practical information: Parking at Vägga IP; changing facilities and showers at Väggahallen. Race numbers can be collected at Intersport in Karlshamn from Wednesday to Saturday, or at the race-day secretariat.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

The event also offers activities for the whole family, including a mascot, prize-giving, face painting and refreshments on site.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km loop with 400 m of elevation gain. After five loops, you’ll have covered the ultra distance of 50 km and 2,000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail running on singletrack and animal trails through dramatic forest! Welcome!
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories
Isaberg Gravel: a circuit of approximately 45 km, starting and finishing in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to age 50: 3 laps, older riders/sport recreation: 2 laps, recreational: 1 lap
additional: Contact GI by mobile at +46 703 815 118 or email at gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Guided rides for cycling groups can be booked; the organisers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group’s needs. Main distance: approximately 10.5 km (Distans Trailtour); Kids Trail: approximately 2 km with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain; start time: Sunday at 12:00; location: Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact: niklas@isabergtrail.se.

name: Walking Dead Ultra 100 Miles
description: Walking Dead Ultra 100 miles is a challenging ultramarathon on a 32 km loop in Paradiset Nature Reserve in Huddinge. Participants can choose from three distances: 100 miles (5 laps), 100 km (3 laps plus an extra course) and 65 km (2 laps). The course follows the Sörmlandsleden trail for most of the way and offers a mix of forest trails and roads. All categories start at the same time, and the race has a 36-hour time limit. Drop bags, a toilet, and access to water, tea, coffee and broth are available to participants at Torpet Paradiset.
course_highlights: The course mostly follows the Sörmlandsleden trail
Each lap is approximately 32 km long
The race takes place in Paradiset Nature Reserve on forest trails and roads
additional: All categories start at the same time, with a maximum time limit of 36 hours. Drop bags can be left at Torpet Paradiset, where there is access to a dry toilet, cold and hot water, tea, coffee and broth. Parking is available, but carpooling is encouraged because space is limited. The start area can be reached by bus or car. At the lap point, water, coffee, tea, broth and a dry toilet are available. Bus 709 runs from Huddinge station to Bruket or Ådran; parking is available, but spaces are limited.

name: Hörby Marknadslopp
description:
Frosta OK is organising an evening race for the 53rd time during Hörby Market, with three different distances:

Marknadsloppet 12.6 km: the competitive class starts at 18:30, and the recreational class starts at 18:40.

Bil-Månsson loppet 6.1 km: everyone starts at 18:50.

CAN-CAN loppet 3.4 km: everyone starts at 19:00.

The race starts and finishes in central Hörby, with much of the route running through woodland.
Varied surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and trails. See maps.

Don't miss this opportunity!
additional:
Register at www.marknadsloppet.nu — right up until the race starts.

Late registration is available at the entrance to Lågehallarna (Byggmästaregatan 4) after 16:00 on race day.

Parking for runners is available at Lågehallarna from 16:00.
Signposting from National Road 13. 55.8552,13.6528

All information about preparations, registration, the course and directions is available at the link:
https://marknadsloppet.nu/information/

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is the most generous race of the year, where the joy of running meets the beautiful scenery of Djurgården. The course winds along gravel and asphalt roads, offering a wonderful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 people to register will receive a specially designed T-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, a relaxing After Run awaits with a barbecue and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. A portion of the registration fee also goes to Sweden for UNHCR, so every step counts—for you and for someone in need.

name: Altorp Ultra
description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop – “Långa gula”.
~120m of elevation per loop.
May 10 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
Run as many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, your friends and family.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!

name: Stora Sköndalsvarvet
description: A beautiful 5-kilometre course (5,100 metres) on roads and trails, starting at Stora Sköndal, passing through the Orhem allotment area and Flatens Nature Reserve. Hilly in places.
additional: Bag drop and race bib collection from 16:30; warm-up at 17:15. No start waves.

name: Hiit Out - Trailrun 2026
description:
Welcome to HIIT OUT – Trailrun – a trail race with challenging running and a wonderful experience in nature!

Choose from four distances: 4 km, 8 km, 12 km or 16 km.

The course takes you through varied terrain, with trails, plenty of elevation gain and sections where you can expect your shoes to get a little wet. It’s not just about the kilometres—the terrain will bring both challenges and running joy along the way.

Four distances. Plenty of trails. Lots of elevation gain. Slightly wet shoes. Everyone aged 15 and over is welcome to take part!

Choose your distance and Hiit Out!

Start times 3/10:
10:30 – 16 km
10:45 – 12 km
11:00 – 8 km
11:15 – 4 km

name: UppLoppet
description: On 6 June 2026, we invite you to UppLoppet—a wonderful running event with 3 km and 10 km distances, filled with the joy of running, community and a festive atmosphere. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best, want to run at a relaxed pace or simply enjoy the atmosphere, UppLoppet is for you. In addition to the race, we’re offering several enjoyable activities for both participants and spectators. Welcome to celebrate movement, health and community with us on National Day!

images.alt_text: Löpare med svenska flaggor springer, UppLoppet 3 km & 10 km, 6 juni.

name: Holje Marknadsloppet
description: The race takes place mainly on pedestrian and cycle paths and trails, with gentle hills.
additional: The race is held in conjunction with Holje Market. The start and finish are at the southern end of the market grounds. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Dannfältshallen. There are also distances for children and young people.

name: Vängeloppet
description: Family-friendly

name: Burlövsloppet
organizer: Arlövs boll- och idrottsförening samt Burlövs kommun
description:
For the fifth year in a row, Burlövsloppet will be held on September 5 in conjunction with Burlövsfesten, right in the center of Burlöv! Anyone can take part, regardless of age, ability, or pace—movement, community, and joy are at the heart of it.

Lilla Burlövsloppet is free; the other races cost SEK 200–250.

name: Vretaloppet
description:
Vreta SoMK welcomes you to a cross-country race in the Olstorp terrain!

Gather your friends, colleagues and teammates, and come to Olstorp. There are races for everyone, big and small.

name: VAIS-loppet
description:
The VAIS race is organised by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn.

The race follows a hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd Nature Reserve, and you can choose between two distances: 4.4 kilometres and 8.4 kilometres.

Both courses start together at 18:30 by the VAIS cabin. After the races, we round things off with coffee and refreshments.
additional: The race is free for members of Växjö AIS. For non-members, the entry fee is 50 kronor.

name: Göinge Spring
description: We invite you to a day dedicated to running and health. Run a half marathon or 10K on an easy-to-run asphalt course, try a 12 km trail race or a shorter 4 km cross-country race. There will be fast, enjoyable courses in wonderful surroundings. If you enjoy being active, mark September 19 in your calendar and make your way to the heart of Göinge, Hässleholm.
additional: https://hassleholmfreeflow.se

name: GUM - Gotland Ultramarathon
description:
One of Sweden’s most beautiful ultramarathons. The race starts at 9:00 at Hallshuk in northern Gotland, and the course heads south along the coast, with the sea on your right all the way to Visby. The route is approximately 50 km, with very varied terrain.

There is also a Half-GUM (28 km), starting at 11:00 in Lickershamn.

name: Uppsala Marathon
description:
UPPSALA MARATHON
17 OCTOBER 2026
Through centuries of history – one step at a time
MARATHON • HALF MARATHON • MARATHON RELAY
Celebrate 10 years with us!
Challenge yourself and experience one of Sweden’s most popular races in beautiful autumnal Uppsala. Run the marathon or half marathon, or gather family, friends or colleagues and take part in the marathon relay.
Uppsala Marathon is turning 10!
Over 42,195 metres, the course takes you through some of Uppsala’s most historic, scenic and remarkable surroundings. From the castle and Carolina Hill to the River Fyris, the city centre and leafy green spaces – a unique combination of running, history, culture and a festive atmosphere.
Whether you’re an experienced marathon runner or taking part for the first time, you’re warmly welcome to help write the next chapter in the race’s history.
All participants are invited to enjoy a post-run gathering, and all finishers receive a technical T-shirt and this year’s exclusive 10th-anniversary medal.
More information and registration:
https://www.uppsalamarathon.se/

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race offers a marked 5 km loop through varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class. The 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course with no hills, offering the chance to achieve good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat, fast course through the heart of the city and along the beautiful shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is a loop course, with 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organised race for all levels.

The race is for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and generous time limits will be set for completing the race.

A warm welcome!
